chunks: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the two rak'ahs of Fajr. He said: 'Pray them before Fajr, with Fajr, and after Fajr.'

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ: The two voluntary rak'ahs of the Fajr prayer

ai.seo_question: When can the two sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr be prayed according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the temporal flexibility of the two sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr, permitting them before the adhan, during the interval before the fard, or after the fard prayer. This ruling highlights the permissibility of performing these voluntary prayers at various stages of the Fajr time window, accommodating different scholarly interpretations of 'before' and 'after' the obligatory prayer. It underscores the practical ease Islam provides for voluntary acts of worship, reinforcing the concept that these sunnah prayers are not strictly bound to a single moment but serve as a means of spiritual preparation and gratitude.
